function.name: check_availability
function.description: Get up to three open 20-minute discovery-call slots from the sales calendar for the next five business days. Call this once you have the caller's email. Returns slot labels and slot_id values.

messages.content: Let me check the calendar, one moment.
I couldn't reach the calendar just now — I'll have the team email you two time options instead.

function.name: book_slot
function.description: Book the discovery call in the chosen slot and send the caller a calendar invite. Use the exact slot_id returned by check_availability.

slot_id.description: The slot_id (ISO 8601 datetime) of the chosen slot from check_availability

email.description: Caller's email address for the invite

need.description: One-line summary of what they want built

messages.content: The booking didn't go through — I'll have the team confirm the time by email.
